title: Exactness of the constructed free module complex on chosen Cech products
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with hom-sets in universe $v$, $R:\mathcal C^{op}\to\mathrm{Ring}$ a presheaf of rings valued in $v$, $T$ a set in $v$, and $f_t:U_t\to U$ a family. Let $S$ specify the chosen products and index maps [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Form $P_n(X)=\coprod_{t\in T^{n+1}}\operatorname{Hom}(X,S.W(n,t))$, with restriction by precomposition and index maps $(t,a)\mapsto(t\circ\alpha,a\circ S.indexMap(t,\alpha))$. Let $K=S.freeComplex(R)$ be the alternating chain complex of objectwise free $R$-module presheaves [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] on this simplicial presheaf. Then $K$ is exact at $n+1$ for every $n\ge0$. No covering or injectivity hypothesis is used.

proof.text: At each object X use the two linear homotopy maps from the objectwise contracting identity. For a cycle x, d(h(x))=x follows by killing the k(d(x)) term. ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff gives exactness of the evaluated adjacent short complex.

Evaluation of module presheaves preserves finite limits and colimits, hence homology. Transport the vanishing of every evaluated homology along mapHomologyIso. Sectionwise hom_ext then shows that the identity of the presheaf homology is zero. Thus the adjacent short complex is exact, and exactAt_iff' gives the unchanged target.
